title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
黄药师尚未教他修炼，若被发现实力，恐怕难以解释。此时，黄雨锋正悠游于桃花林，系统相助，桃花岛的阵法对他毫无影响。“小师弟，你在哪？”梅超锋的声音传来，黄雨锋赶紧回应。“梅师姐，我在这儿，你找我是有事吗？”听到回应，梅超锋很快找到他，将他抱起。“你这小子，怎么总往桃林跑，不怕迷路吗？”梅超锋半开玩笑地说。“梅师姐，你知道的，这阵法困不住我。”黄雨锋得意地回答。听他说完，梅超锋不禁感叹：“不知道你是什么怪胎，这阵法对你完全不起作用，我们研究了好几年才搞清楚。”被称作怪胎，黄雨锋自然不服气，反驳道：“梅师姐，我才不是怪胎，是天赋异禀。”梅超锋被逗得笑了起来。黄雨锋天赋出众，得到了黄药师的认可。一天，梅超锋奉命来找黄雨锋，告诉他师父在等他们一起去大厅。黄雨锋随梅超锋赶到后，见到众人已在场，便向师父黄药师行礼。黄药师满意地点点头，告诉大家即将前往华山参加论剑大会，以决定《九阴真经》的归属。这是南宋武林的一件大事，王重阳将主持此会，避免江湖纷争。黄雨锋听后兴奋地请求同行，但黄药师考虑到论剑的严肃性，认为他年纪尚小，不便同行，嘱咐他留在家中好好修行。黄雨锋虽感遗憾，却也听话地答应了，还祝愿师父胜利归来。众人见他认真又可爱的模样，无不忍俊不禁。黄雨锋感到十分苦恼，觉得小孩子总是麻烦，希望他们能快快长大。"好了，今天叫大家来主要是这件事，如果没有别的事，就散了吧。”"是，师傅告退。”第二天，黄药师准备前往华山参加论剑，众人来到海边。冯蘅担忧地看着他。"药师，此行务必小心。”"阿蘅，你别担心，我的实力你应该清楚。在这南宋武林，除非那些老怪物出山，否则没人能留得住我。再说，这不过是切磋论剑，并非生死相搏，我不会有事的。”"药师，我担心的不是南宋武林。华山由南宋和大明各占一半，我怕到时候那边也会有人掺和进来，毕竟我们对大明武林并不熟悉。”"阿蘅，你放宽心，我会平安归来的。即便大明有人来，也掀不起什么大浪，你就安心吧，我出发了。”黄药师说完便走向船头。目送他离去后，冯蘅抱着黄雨锋回到书房，将他放在椅子上。随后，她从书架取出《千字文》，来到凌阳面前。"雨锋，娘现在教你认字读书，等你师父回来就能教你练功了。”

"好啊娘，我会好好学的，将来要做个厉害的人，保护您和师父。”听黄雨锋这样说，冯蘅很开心。"你这小机灵鬼，师父根本不用你保护，他自己就很厉害，你只需护着我就成。”"娘为何不习武呢？提升实力还能延年益寿呢。”"娘以前从未接触过武艺，如今年纪大了，学也晚了。”冯蘅说完，有些失落。"怎么可能？娘这么年轻，怎么会老呢？一定有适合您的修炼方法。娘放心，这事包在我身上。”黄雨锋的话让冯蘅很是感动，这么小的孩子竟如此体贴。"雨锋，你能这样想娘就很欣慰了。至于能不能修炼，娘其实并不在意。”黄雨锋还想说什么，被冯蘅拦住了。"好了雨锋，现在别说了，咱们开始学认字吧。”冯蘅坐下后翻开《千字文》。"雨锋，我们要一起读，一会儿我可要考考你哦。”尽管黄雨锋识得这些字，还是装作不懂的样子，跟着冯蘅朗读起来。冯蘅："天地玄黄，宇宙洪荒。日月盈昃，辰宿列张。”天地玄黄，宇宙洪荒。日月盈昃，辰宿列张。黄雨锋诵读得极为流畅，冯蘅满意地点头，接着继续传授新的内容。两个月后，黄药师归来。书房中常传来两人读书的声音，温馨而和谐。冯蘅上午教黄雨锋识字，下午则指导他练习写字，态度十分认真。起初，黄雨锋并未表现出一日之内熟记千字文的能力，但他仅用三天便能默写出整本千字文。冯蘅惊叹其天赋异禀，并发现黄雨锋同样具备过目不忘的才能，这令她倍感欣慰。时间飞逝，两个月悄然过去。冯蘅认为自己已无更多知识可授，毕竟武功并非其所长。她不禁疑惑，这孩子是否真如天人下凡。想起他初次出现于山林时的情景，周围并无村庄，不像被人遗弃。某日，黄雨锋独自在山洞内修炼，计划冲击三流中期境界。若此事为人所知，定会引起轰动——一位仅一岁出头的孩子竟已达此修为，实在难以置信。片刻之后，黄雨锋睁开双眼，面露喜色。”总算成功了！”他自语道，“得赶紧回去，免得师父担心我去海边玩耍。”回到住所不久，冯蘅果然前来探望。”雨锋，没乱跑吧？千万莫往海边去，那里波涛汹涌，独自行走太危险。”她叮嘱道。“娘亲放心，我不会去的。”黄雨锋乖巧回应。
content_en:
Huang Yaoshi has not yet taught him how to practice. If his strength is discovered, it may be difficult to explain.At this time, Huang Yufeng was swimming leisurely in the peach blossom forest, and the system was helping him. The formations on Peach Blossom Island had no effect on him."Junior brother, where are you?" Mei Chaofeng's voice came, and Huang Yufeng responded quickly."Senior Sister Mei, I'm here, are you looking for me for something?" After hearing the response, Mei Chaofeng quickly found him and picked him up."You kid, why do you always run to Taolin? Aren't you afraid of getting lost?" Mei Chaofeng said half-jokingly."Senior Sister Mei, you know that this formation cannot trap me." Huang Yufeng replied proudly.After hearing what he said, Mei Chaofeng couldn't help but sigh: "I don't know what kind of freak you are. This formation will not work on you at all. We studied it for several years before we figured it out." Huang Yufeng was naturally unconvinced by being called a freak and retorted: "Sister Mei, I am not a freak, I am a genius." Mei Chaofeng was amused and laughed.Huang Yufeng has outstanding talent and has been recognized by Huang Yaoshi.One day, Mei Chaofeng was ordered to come to Huang Yufeng and tell him that the master was waiting for them to go to the hall together.After Huang Yufeng arrived with Mei Chaofeng, he saw everyone present and saluted his master Huang Yaoshi.Huang Yaoshi nodded with satisfaction and told everyone that he was about to go to Huashan to participate in the Sword Discussion Conference to decide the ownership of the "Nine Yin Manual".This is a major event in the martial arts world of the Southern Song Dynasty. Wang Chongyang will preside over this meeting to avoid disputes in the world.After hearing this, Huang Yufeng excitedly asked to go with him, but Huang Yaoshi, considering the seriousness of the sword discussion, thought that he was too young to go with him, and asked him to stay at home and practice hard.Although Huang Yufeng felt regretful, he obediently agreed and wished the master a victorious return.Everyone couldn't help laughing when they saw his serious and cute appearance.Huang Yufeng felt very distressed. He felt that children were always in trouble and hoped that they would grow up quickly."Okay, this is the main reason why I called you here today. If there is nothing else, let's leave." "Yes, master, I'm resigning." The next day, Huang Yaoshi was going to Mount Huashan to participate in a sword debate, and everyone came to the beach.Feng Heng looked at him worriedly."Physician, you must be careful on this trip." "Ahen, don't worry, you should know my strength. In this Southern Song Dynasty Wulin, no one can keep me unless those old monsters come out. Besides, this is just a sword fight, not a life and death fight. I will be fine." "Physician, I am not worried about the Southern Song Wulin.Huashan is divided into half from the Southern Song Dynasty and the Ming Dynasty. I'm afraid that someone from there will get involved.After all, we are not familiar with the martial arts of the Ming Dynasty."Ah Heng, please relax, I will return safely. Even if someone from the Ming Dynasty comes, it won't make any big waves. Don't worry, I will set off towards the bow."After watching him leave, Feng Heng carried Huang Yufeng back to the study and placed him on a chair.Then, she took out "The Thousand Character Essay" from the bookshelf and came to Ling Yang."Yu Feng, mother will teach you how to read and read now. When your master comes back, he will teach you how to practice kung fu."

"Okay, mother, I will study hard and be a powerful person in the future, protecting you and Master." Feng Heng was very happy to hear what Huang Yufeng said."You little clever guy, Master doesn't need you to protect him at all. He is very powerful on his own. All you have to do is protect me." "Why don't you practice martial arts? Improving your strength can also prolong your life." "My mother has never been exposed to martial arts before. Now that I am older, it is too late to learn." After Feng Heng finished speaking, he felt a little disappointed."How is it possible? Mom is so young, how can she grow old? There must be a cultivation method suitable for you. Don't worry, Mom, this matter will be taken care of by me." Huang Yufeng's words moved Feng Heng very much. Such a young child could be so considerate."Yufeng, I'm very happy that you can think of mother like this. As for whether you can practice or not, mother actually doesn't care." Huang Yufeng wanted to say something else, but was stopped by Feng Heng."Okay Yufeng, stop talking now, let's start learning to read." Feng Heng sat down and opened the "Thousand Character Essay"."Yufeng, we are going to read together. I will test you later." Although Huang Yufeng knew these words, he still pretended not to understand and read aloud after Feng Heng.Feng Heng: "The sky and the earth are dark and yellow, and the universe is ancient. The sun and the moon are waxing, and the stars and constellations are arranged." The sky and the earth are dark and yellow, and the universe is ancient.The sun and moon are full, and the stars and constellations are arranged.Huang Yufeng read very smoothly. Feng Heng nodded with satisfaction and continued to teach new content.Two months later, Huang Yaoshi returned.The sound of two people reading can often be heard in the study, which is warm and harmonious.Feng Heng taught Huang Yufeng how to read in the morning and guided him to practice writing in the afternoon, with a very serious attitude.At first, Huang Yufeng did not show the ability to memorize the thousand-character essay in one day, but he was able to write the entire thousand-character essay silently in just three days.Feng Heng marveled at his extraordinary talent and found that Huang Yufeng also had the talent of photographic memory, which made her even more gratified.Time flies, and two months pass quietly.Feng Heng felt that he had no more knowledge to teach, after all, martial arts was not his strong point.She couldn't help but wonder whether this child was really like a man from heaven.Recalling the scene when he first appeared in the mountains and forests, there were no villages around, and it didn't look like he was abandoned.One day, Huang Yufeng was practicing alone in a cave, planning to hit the mid-level third-rate realm.If this matter were known, it would definitely cause a sensation - it is unbelievable that a child who is only one year old has reached such a level of cultivation.After a while, Huang Yufeng opened his eyes and looked happy."It finally worked!" He said to himself, "I have to go back quickly, lest Master worry about me going to play at the beach." Not long after returning to his residence, Feng Heng came to visit."Yu Feng, are you not running around? Don't go to the beach. The waves are rough there and walking alone is too dangerous," she warned."Don't worry, mother, I won't go." Huang Yufeng responded obediently.
